left.title: Michael Cohen Tape Suggests Team Trump Lied About Karen McDougal
left.body: In the recording, Trump discussed a payment he supposedly knew nothing about.
left.roundup: President Trump's ex-lawyer Michael Cohen reportedly recorded a conversation in which they discussed a payment made to a former Playboy model who said she had an affair with Trump.

center.title: Michael Cohen taped Trump discussing payment to a Playboy model
center.body: President Donald Trump's lawyer Michael Cohen secretly recorded a conversation in which he and Trump discussed payments to a former Playboy model who claimed to have had an affair with Trump, a person familiar with the matter said Friday.
center.roundup: President Trump's ex-lawyer Michael Cohen reportedly recorded a conversation in which they discussed a payment made to a former Playboy model who said she had an affair with Trump.

right.title: Larry Klayman: Unethical for Cohen to Secretly Tape Trump
right.body: Attorney Michael Cohen went against ethics guidelines by allegedly making a secret recording of a conversation he had with then-candidate Donald Trump in 2016, Freedom Watch founder Larry Klayman told Newsmax TV.
right.roundup: President Trump's ex-lawyer Michael Cohen reportedly recorded a conversation in which they discussed a payment made to a former Playboy model who said she had an affair with Trump.
